subject: Retention credits & cross-vendor split proposal for Datadog / Grafana
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Koh <evan.koh@datadog.com>, Sienna Park <sienna@grafana.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@sentry.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Retention credits & cross-vendor split proposal for Datadog / Grafana

Team —

Following our internal review of Q4 retention spend, we think there’s a practical path to reduce monthly costs ~30% without impacting SLOs by splitting cold storage between Grafana Cloud cold-tier (logs/metrics) and our S3 bucket (long-tail artifacts), plus moving lower-RTO error traces to Sentry. I put a one-page split and usage breakdown in the attachment (Retention-split-proposal-2026-11-20.xlsx).

As vendors, we’re looking for two things from you:
- Datadog: can we get a retrospective credit for the heavy ingest spikes in Oct (see RDW-Datadog-Usage-Report-Oct2026.csv) and an updated quote for a reduced live retention window (30 -> 14 days) with an archive egress allowance?
- Grafana Cloud: can you provide a revised cold-tier rate if we commit to a 12-month cold-store volume (we’d like a draft quote / DocuSign link)?
- Sentry: confirm whether moving low-resolution traces off-prem affects our plan tier and if there’s a migration assistance credit.

Internal folks — Ben/Laura, can finance sign off on a pilot if vendors provide the credits and a 30% projected savings? Karthik, please flag any procurement gating (legal language, data residency). Vivek, can infra provide a quick feasibility note on S3 lifecycle policies by EOD Friday?

Thanks — looking to consolidate vendor responses so we can present a single plan to execs next Wed.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Retention-split-proposal-2026-11-20.xlsx (spreadsheet), RDW-Datadog-Usage-Report-Oct2026.csv (csv), Grafana-Cloud-Quote-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Evan Koh <evan.koh@datadog.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sienna Park <sienna@grafana.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@sentry.io>
Date: 2026-11-20T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credits & cross-vendor split proposal for Datadog / Grafana

Monica —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the usage CSV. Quick answers from our side:
1) Retrospective credit: we can offer a one-time credit equal to 20% of the Oct overage tied to your committed baseline if you accept a 12-month modified retention contract (reducing live retention to 14 days) — draft credit note attached.
2) Archive egress: we can include 50GB/month of no-charge egress to your S3 for the first 3 months of the migration and then 10GB/month thereafter as a promotion tied to a 12-month commit.
3) Pricing: I’m attaching a redline of standard price -> proposed price for the 14-day window plus archive option.

If Grafana can reciprocate on cold-tier pricing and Sentry confirms trace migration cost is minimal, this should be doable. I’ll also loop in our finance & compliance folks if you want the credit documented as a PO-level amendment.

Cheers,
Evan
Evan Koh
Account Exec, Datadog
---
Attachments: DD-credit-proposal-Nov2026.pdf

From: Sienna Park <sienna@grafana.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Evan Koh <evan.koh@datadog.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credits & cross-vendor split proposal for Datadog / Grafana

Hi Monica —

Appreciate the proposal. We can offer a tiered cold-storage discount if you commit to a predictable monthly ingest (table in attached PDF). For commercial terms:
- 10% off cold-tier storage at 12-month commit, 18% off at 24-month commit.
- We can provide a 30-day pilot waiver on transfer costs for the first 5TB of cold moves (we’ll coordinate with Datadog on the handoff).

Legal note: we need a simple addendum for the data routing (Grafana -> S3) and to confirm no change to retention in Grafana’s active index. If you can share the proposed addendum language we’ll fast-track. I attached a draft quote and a proposed addendum template (Grafana-Cloud-Quote-v2.pdf).

Best,
Sienna
Sienna Park
Commercial Lead, Grafana Cloud
---
Attachments: Grafana-Cloud-Quote-v2.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credits & cross-vendor split proposal for Datadog / Grafana

Folks —

Quick procurement scan of the vendor responses so far:
- Datadog credit and egress allowance: acceptable as a commercial concession, but we need the credit tied to an amendment and an SOW for the migration window. Legal will require both.
- Grafana addendum: we should insist on explicit residency language for cold-tier copies (US-only) and a clause that Grafana will not index archived records without our consent.
- Sentry: I pinged Marta for concrete numbers; ask for migration assistance and a transient support credit.

Action items:
- Monica: please confirm if Redwood is comfortable with a 12-month commit vs. 24-month and whether finance will approve the pilot funding.
- Ben/Laura (Finance): need a quick ROI table showing projected monthly savings and break-even. I attached a short procurement checklist in the Drive link.

Karthik
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Retention credits & cross-vendor split proposal for Datadog / Grafana

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. I reviewed the vendor replies and the split deck. High level: I’m supportive of running a 90-day pilot under the proposed Datadog credit and Grafana pilot waiver, provided:
1) Legal signs the addendum with US-only residency and a kill-switch for reindexing;
2) We cap the pilot spend at $45k net (post-credit) and require weekly spend telemetry;
3) Sentry provides migration support or we reduce scope for traces during pilot.

Monica — proceed to get the addenda drafted and route to Legal + Finance for signatures. If vendors can get DocuSign links by Tue next week we’ll greenlight the pilot.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Cloud Economics, Redwood Inference
